pairs.target: shān bèi huà dé xiàng yíkuài qièkāi de miànbǐng .

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiān rènchū le dǐngshàng de zhōnglóu , zài rènchū zhōnglóu páng de xùshuǐchí .

pairs.target: wǎng xià , mìmìde xiéxiàn lǐ jiá zhe jǐtiáo kòngbái , yǒu de tōng dào shānbì , yǒu de zài bàntú shōuzhù .

pairs.target: zhǎo le bàntiān , zhǐjiān què luò zài yìtiáo páishuǐgōu shàng .
pairs.english: After a long search, his fingertip landed on a drainage channel instead.
pairs.hanzi: 找了半天，指尖却落在一条排水沟上。

pairs.target: nài lěi bǎ tú zhuǎnzhèng . "

奈蕾把图转正。

pairs.target: cóng zhèlǐ kàn . nǐ zhàn zài chéngnán , duì zhe běibiān , děngyú bǎ qiánmiàn de bànzuò shān názǒu le . "
pairs.english: “Look from here. You're standing south of the city, facing north—as though the nearer half of the mountain has been removed.”

pairs.target: tā shùnzhe tā de shǒu kàn guòqù , hūrán dǒng le nà piàn kòngbái wèishénme bù wān .
pairs.english: Following her hand, he suddenly understood why that blank strip did not bend.
pairs.hanzi: 他顺着她的手看过去，忽然懂了那片空白为什么不弯。

pairs.target: tā búshì píngmiàn shàng de lù , shì yìtiáo chuānguò yáncéng de dòng . "
pairs.english: It was not a road seen from above, but a tunnel through the rock.
pairs.hanzi:
它不是平面上的路，是一条穿过岩层的洞。

pairs.target: zhè xiàmiàn yǒurén zhù ? " " xiànzài méiyǒu . nǐ kàn rìqī . "
pairs.english: “Do people live down here?” “Not now. Look at the date.”
pairs.hanzi:
这下面有人住？”
“现在没有。你看日期。”

pairs.target: tú yǐjīng yǒu qīshíduōnián le .
pairs.english: The drawing was already more than seventy years old.
pairs.hanzi: 图已经有七十多年了。

pairs.target: zuǒxiàjiǎo lìng tiēzhe yípiàn xīn zhǐ , zhùmíng liǎngchù rùkǒu hòulái fēng le , yíchù gǎizuò cúnliáng .
pairs.english: A newer slip pasted at the lower left noted that two entrances had later been sealed, and another converted for grain storage.
pairs.hanzi: 左下角另贴着一片新纸，注明两处入口后来封了，一处改作存粮。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi mōlemō běnzi lǐ de diànbǎn , bǎ zhōnglóu huà dé jíxiǎo .
pairs.english: Tavi felt the backing board in his notebook and drew the bell tower very small.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维摸了摸本子里的垫板，把钟楼画得极小。

pairs.target: huà dào dòngkǒu , tā yòu tíngzhù :
pairs.english: He stopped again at the tunnel mouth:
pairs.hanzi: 画到洞口，他又停住：

pairs.target: yǐqián tā cóng huī ào wǎng shàng wàng , zǒng juéde zhōnglóu láoláo cháng zài zhěngzuò shāndǐng shàng , xiànzài xiàmiàn jìng yǒu zhème duō kōng chù .
pairs.english: Looking up from AshHollow before, he had always felt the tower grew firmly out of the whole mountaintop; now there were so many hollow places underneath.
pairs.hanzi: 以前他从灰坳往上望，总觉得钟楼牢牢长在整座山顶上，现在下面竟有这么多空处。

pairs.target: nài lěi qǔ lái lìng yìzhāng báo tú , yánzhe jiù tú de biānjiǎo yā hǎo .
pairs.english: Nerai brought another thin drawing and secured it along the old drawing's corners.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾取来另一张薄图，沿着旧图的边角压好。

pairs.target: jǐgēn hóngxiàn luò zài dòng bì fùjìn , bù quán xiānglián , yě bù yánzhe dàolù zǒu . "
pairs.english: Several red lines lay near the tunnel walls; they did not all connect, nor did they follow the roads.
pairs.hanzi:
几根红线落在洞壁附近，不全相连，也不沿着道路走。
“

pairs.english: “These are old components that have been located. Only where the positions match do we trace them onto this.
pairs.hanzi: 这些是查到的旧构件。位置对得上的，才描上来。

pairs.target: xūxiàn shì jiù chāoběn lǐ de , bié liánchéng yìgēn . "
pairs.english: The dashed lines come from old copies. Don't join them into a single line.”
pairs.hanzi: 虚线是旧抄本里的，别连成一根。”

pairs.target: tā shēnchū qù de bǐ suō le huílái . "
pairs.english: He drew back his outstretched pen.
pairs.hanzi:
他伸出去的笔缩了回来。
“

pairs.target: yǒuxiē yuánběn jiù fēnkāi . yǒuxiē hòulái huàn le shí chēng , jiù tiě hái liúzài lǐmiàn .
pairs.english: “Some were separate from the start. Others later had stone supports fitted, with the old iron still left inside.
pairs.hanzi: 有些原本就分开。有些后来换了石撑，旧铁还留在里面。

pairs.target: nǐ bǎ tāmen jiē qǐlái , jiù huà chū le méi rén jiàn guò de dōngxī . "
pairs.english: If you connect them, you'll draw something nobody has ever seen.”
pairs.hanzi: 你把它们接起来，就画出了没人见过的东西。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎngqǐ běi gōngfáng , wèn nàbiān yě yǒu zhèzhǒng tú méiyǒu .
pairs.english: Tavi thought of the north workshop and asked whether they had a drawing like this for it.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想起北工房，问那边也有这种图没有。

pairs.target: nài lěi shuō yǒu júbù de , xīn cháchū de jiēdiǎn zhèngzài bǔ ; zhè zhāng bùnéng nálái chá nà jiān wūzi .
pairs.english: Nerai said there were partial ones, and the newly discovered connections were being added; this drawing could not be used to inspect that room.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾说有局部的，新查出的接点正在补；这张不能拿来查那间屋子。

pairs.target: tā jiēkāi báozhǐ , lùchū shānjiǎoxià yìpái xìxiǎo de fānggé .

pairs.hanzi: 她揭开薄纸，露出山脚下一排细小的方格。

pairs.english: Tavi took them for a scale, but on looking closely saw trees drawn beside them.
pairs.hanzi:
塔维以为是标尺，仔细看，方格旁还画着树。

pairs.english: “Houses?” “Old Garden Street. My grandmother came here as a child with the vegetable sellers.”
pairs.hanzi:
房子？”

pairs.hanzi: 他把脸凑近。那些房子紧挨着山脚，离如今的下货场还要远。

pairs.target: tú páng de xiǎozì shuō , shuǐ céng yāndào dìèrpái wū , tuìhòu liúxià de ní bǎ jǐngkǒu mái le .

pairs.hanzi: 图旁的小字说，水曾淹到第二排屋，退后留下的泥把井口埋了。

后来修了上面的石阶，几户人搬到了半山。

pairs.hanzi:
所以大家才往山上住？”

pairs.english: “Those households did,” Nerai said. “Copperstep is much older than that flood.

pairs.target: nǐ yào wèn suǒyǒurén , jiù bùnéng zhī kàn zhè yíyè . "
pairs.english: If you want to ask about everyone, you can't look at just this page.”
pairs.hanzi: 你要问所有人，就不能只看这一页。”

pairs.hanzi: 塔维有点失望。他已经想好了一个很大的答案，

下面写着旧圃街重修井台。

pairs.english: “People went back after the flood receded?” “Of course. Who else would rebuild the well platform?”
pairs.hanzi:
水退了以后，还有人回去？”
“当然。不然谁重修井台？”

pairs.target: tā shuō dé tài kuài , suíjí yòu bǎ huà lājìn , biàn le biàn biānshàng de xiǎozì . "
pairs.english: She had answered too quickly; she pulled the picture closer and peered at the small writing along its edge.

她说得太快，随即又把画拉近，辨了辨边上的小字。

pairs.english: “It doesn't actually say who rebuilt it. Don't write that down just because I said it.”
pairs.hanzi: 这句倒没写是谁修的。你别照我的话记。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiào le yíxià , zài běnzi shàng huà le yígè jǐng quān .

pairs.hanzi: 塔维笑了一下，在本子上画了一个井圈。

pairs.target: tā xiǎngqǐ lù tīng de nà zhāng jiù tú , xiǎngqǐ lán xiù xìn lǐ de miàn dài .

pairs.target: nàxiē dìmíng zài zhǐ shàng zǒng jǐ zài shān de biānyuán , dú qǐlái què kāishǐ bǐ shān hái zhàn dìfāng . "

那些地名在纸上总挤在山的边缘，读起来却开始比山还占地方。

pairs.target: xiànzài hái shèng shénme ? " " jiù pǔ jiē ? yǒu jǐpiàn càidì .
pairs.english: “What's left now?” “Old Garden Street? A few vegetable plots.

现在还剩什么？”
“旧圃街？有几片菜地。

pairs.target: jǐng shìbushì zhè kǒu , wǒ méi chá guò . cóng nánlù jīngguò , qíngtiān néng kànjiàn . " "
pairs.english: I haven't checked whether the well is this one. You can see the place from the south road in clear weather.”
pairs.hanzi:
井是不是这口，我没查过。从南路经过，晴天能看见。”

alignment.english: see the place from the south road

pairs.target: nǐ dàiwǒqù guò de nàtiáo lù ? " " búshì . nàtiáo piānxī . zhǎozhǎokàn . "
pairs.english: “The road you took me along?” “No. That one is farther west. Try finding it.”
pairs.hanzi:
你带我去过的那条路？”
“不是。那条偏西。找找看。”

pairs.target: zhèhuí nài lěi méiyǒu tì tā zhuǎn tú .
pairs.english: This time Nerai did not turn the drawing for him.
pairs.hanzi: 这回奈蕾没有替他转图。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng zhōnglóu cháozhe zìjǐ , xuán le bànquān , yòu xuán huílái ,
pairs.english: Tavi faced the bell tower toward himself, turned it half a turn, then back again,
pairs.hanzi: 塔维将钟楼朝着自己，旋了半圈，又旋回来，

pairs.target: zhōngyú cóng chéngmén páng zhǎochū xiàng nán xiàpō de xìxiàn .

pairs.hanzi: 终于从城门旁找出向南下坡的细线。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu zuānjìn shāntǐ , érshì tiēzhe wàimiàn de pō zǒu , zài tú biān guǎichū le zhǐmiàn .
pairs.english: It did not burrow into the mountain, but followed its outer slope, curving off the paper at the edge.

pairs.target: chuāngwài zhuànlái sàozhou cā dì de shēngyīn .

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhè cái fāxiàn , zhuō jiǎo de yángguāng yǐjīng yí dào zìjǐ de xī shàng .

pairs.hanzi: 塔维这才发现，桌角的阳光已经移到自己的膝上。

pairs.target: tā hái xiǎng fān xià yíyè , nài lěi què bǎ báo tú yìcéngcéng shōu hǎo , shuō jīntiān jiù dào zhèlǐ ,
pairs.english: He wanted to turn another page, but Nerai put the thin drawings away, layer by layer, saying that was enough for today;

pairs.target: zìjǐ háiyào qù lǐng tónghángrén de cè jù .
pairs.english: She still had to collect measuring instruments for her companions.
pairs.hanzi: 自己还要去领同行人的测具。

pairs.target: tā bāng tā tào shàng zhǐtào , jiāng huà le jǐng quān de nà yè chuīgān .

pairs.hanzi: 他帮她套上纸套，将画了井圈的那页吹干。

pairs.target: xiàlóu shí , cóng chuāngkǒu néng wàngjiàn xùshuǐchí de wéilán , lánwài jǐgè xuéshēng zhèng jǔ zhe yīfu zhuīfēng .
pairs.english: Going downstairs, he could see the reservoir railings through a window, with students holding clothes up and chasing the wind beyond them.
pairs.hanzi: 下楼时，从窗口能望见蓄水池的围栏，栏外几个学生正举着衣服追风。

pairs.target: zhōnglóu dǎngzhù le nánbiān de shānpō , càidì , jiù jǐng hé nàtiáo chū le zhǐmiàn de lù , quán zài shìxiàn zhīwài .
pairs.english: The bell tower blocked the southern slope: the vegetable plots, old well and road beyond the page were all out of sight.
pairs.hanzi: 钟楼挡住了南边的山坡，菜地、旧井和那条出了纸面的路，全在视线之外。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu duō zhàn . mǐlā dāying tì tā liú fàn , zài wǎn lián guō biān de cuì mǐ yě lúnbúdào tā le .
pairs.english: He did not linger. Mira had promised to save him dinner; any later and even the crisp rice around the pot's edge would be gone.
pairs.hanzi: 他没有多站。米拉答应替他留饭，再晚连锅边的脆米也轮不到他了。
